verdict.rationale: Only one independent source (TechPowerUp) confirms the RX 9070 XT delivers competitive raster/ray-tracing performance versus similarly priced NVIDIA cards, but it doesn't specifically address 4K high-refresh benchmarks or vendor FPS claims. Missing for 10: explicit vendor 4K/144Hz+ performance claims, detailed independent 4K benchmark numbers across multiple games, and confirmation of sustained high-refresh framerates.
